visualCharacteristics.purpose: Pricing cards (no image) with eyebrow, plan name, price, feature list, tagline, price-lock note and CTA; emits Product/Offer JSON-LD
observed: Three plan cards (Essentials, Unleashed, Unleashed Max): eyebrow, plan name, 'Starting at', price, term, feature list, tagline, price-lock note, CTA

contentPattern.structure: one row per plan, one cell: eyebrow paragraph, h3 plan name, "Starting at", price paragraph with strong ($39.99/mo.), term, ul of features, tagline paragraph, ":lock: ..." note, CTA link

usage: Plan cards in fragment /viasatinternet/fragments/plans (with ** / *** footnotes). Each card with a heading and a strong $ price adds a Product (name, description = tagline, Offer price/priceCurrency USD/url = CTA) to <script id="product-jsonld"> via scripts/structured-data.js upsertProductJsonLd().
reuseGuidance: Author as "Cards Plans (featured 2)" to highlight the BEST VALUE (2nd) card. The price must be a paragraph with strong, not a heading.
